analytics.name: Analytic 1858
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a process or scheduled task whose displayed name matches a known Industrial Control System (ICS) vendor application but whose on-disk binary hash or file path does not match the vendor-signed baseline. The mismatch -- name says one thing, binary integrity says another -- is the defining signal. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.
